messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman faces the camera and speaks, her mouth moving and her expression shifting from a slight smile to a more neutral look.","camera":"A medium close-up, front-facing shot that slowly zooms in on the woman's face.","clothing":"A bright pink, off-the-shoulder top with dark straps visible on the shoulders.","hair_color":"Blonde.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair with straight bangs, styled into two high buns on top of her head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with dark skin, brown eyes, and a small mole on her left cheek.","scene":"A futuristic, neon-lit environment at night, featuring a large glass dome structure with pink and blue lights in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output replaces the source's side-view full-body walking shot with a front-facing medium close-up of the woman's face and upper chest. The camera slowly moves closer, and the woman now faces the camera and appears to speak, with her mouth moving and expression changing. The background remains the same futuristic dome scene, though the framing and lighting differ from the source.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera to a front-facing close-up of the person's face, using the reference for initial framing, while preserving appearance, expression, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the slow zoom and initial framing exactly match the provided reference image.
unexpected_changes: The person's action changed from walking in profile to facing the camera and speaking.
The person's expression changed from a neutral side profile to a frontal smile and talking motion.
The clothing appears as an off-the-shoulder pink top rather than the source's fitted long-sleeve pink top.
The hair appears blonde with bangs and two buns, differing from the source's reddish-brown single bun.
The source's full-body framing and walking progression were not preserved.
